questions.subtopic: Decline of Indian Cotton Textile Exports
questions.question: Due to high British import tariffs, what happened to the share of fine Indian cotton textile manufactures in India's total exports between 1800 and 1870?
options: It increased from 10% to 80%
It remained completely unchanged at 50%
It overtook British textile manufacturing in volume
It crashed from over 30% in 1800 to below 3% by the 1870s
questions.explanation: British protective tariffs shut out Indian manufactured cloth. Consequently, Indian cotton textiles collapsed from over 30% of India's exports around 1800 to under 3% by the 1870s, as India was transformed into a supplier of raw materials.
